classification.difficultyReason: Choose the direction and position of a straight fit by balancing the point cloud, including recognising an approximately horizontal fit for the third plot.

content.prompt: Sketch lines of best fit to these scatterplots.

spec.description: Ten black crosses on unscaled arrowed axes, with italic x and y labels.
spec.mathematics: Strong positive linear association; marker placement reconstructed from the printed figure, without assigning data values.
spec.answerVisibility: No best-fit line in the question.

answer.short: An upward-sloping straight line through the middle of the points. Other reasonable sketches are acceptable.
answer.worked: Draw one straight line following the positive trend, close to the points, with roughly equal numbers above and below. Keep its endpoints within the observed horizontal range. The diagram shows one acceptable example.

spec.description: Example upward-sloping line in the exact base coordinate frame and bounding box.
spec.mathematics: By-eye example, not a unique regression answer.

spec.description: Ten black crosses on unscaled arrowed x and y axes.
spec.mathematics: Strong negative linear association; coordinates describe graphic placement only.
spec.answerVisibility: No best-fit line in the question.

answer.short: A downward-sloping straight line through the middle of the points. Other reasonable sketches are acceptable.
answer.worked: Draw one straight line following the negative trend, close to the points, with roughly equal numbers above and below. Keep its endpoints within the observed horizontal range. The diagram shows one acceptable example.

spec.description: Example downward-sloping line in the exact base frame.
Twelve black crosses in a roughly horizontal band on unscaled axes.
spec.mathematics: Little linear association; graphic coordinates are not numerical observations.
spec.answerVisibility: No best-fit line in the question.

answer.short: An approximately horizontal straight line through the middle of the points. Other reasonable sketches are acceptable.
answer.worked: The points have little upward or downward trend. Draw an approximately horizontal straight line through their middle, with roughly equal numbers above and below, confined to the observed horizontal range.

spec.description: Example horizontal line in the exact base frame.
spec.mathematics: An acceptable by-eye fit to a nearly horizontal band.
